fields.description: Game option toggles packed as flag bits (sound/music/hints style switches).
fields.evidence: FUN_080450a0 gates progress on a masked flag test (*(u16*)(state+0xe) & 0x22)==0 and stores byte flags at state+0x5a/0x5b=0 with enable byte +0x5d=1; FUN_08046c7c stores option-like byte fields at struct+5/+6/+7 and 0xff sentinel at +0xb. Save offset 0x200 reads 0x00 in baseline.
fields.name: options_flags

fields.description: Difficulty selector (labels are conventional; stored as one byte).
fields.evidence: FUN_08046c7c uses byte field at struct+4 as a scaled table index (idx*0x18 into the level table at iVar3) with sibling byte countdowns at struct+8/+9 in FUN_08046eac; single-byte indexed selectors of this shape carry difficulty. Save offset 0x201 reads 0x00 (Easy) in baseline.
fields.name: difficulty_level

fields.description: Hub/world index clamped to the 13-entry threshold table.
fields.evidence: FUN_080450a0 walks a 13-entry (0xd) u16 threshold table at DAT_08045194, clamping a state u16 into bucket 0..12 (uVar9=0xc fallback); world/area selectors use this bucketed index. Save offset 0x202 reads 0x00 in baseline.
fields.name: hub_world_index

fields.evidence: FUN_08046c7c maintains a u16 counter at struct+0x26 (bounded compare vs table byte at iVar3+0x11, incremented per entry, scaled *8 table indexing); FUN_08046eac reads/writes companion u16 words at struct+0x10/+0x2a. Save offset 0x204 reads 0x0000 in baseline.
fields.name: story_progress

fields.evidence: FUN_08046eac counts down byte/signed-byte fields at struct+8 (iVar5=(byte)(x)-1 loop while >0) and struct+9 (decrement-to-below-1 branch); lives-style countdown idiom. Save offset 0x206 reads 0x00 in baseline.
fields.name: lives_count

fields.description: Current map/node id, 6-bit masked index into the node table.
fields.evidence: FUN_08046eac stores a u16 at struct+0x2a masked with & 0x3f (6-bit node id, range 0..63) and scales it through the lookup table at DAT_08046f64. Save offset 0x208 reads 0x0000 in baseline.
fields.name: map_node_index

fields.description: Collectible/unlock bitfield (one bit per gem shard / secret).
fields.evidence: FUN_080450a0 gates progress on (*(u16*)(state+0xe) & 0x22)==0; collectible completion is tracked as bit flags over a wide word, zero-initialized by FUN_08022a20 (u32 word at struct+0x6c=0). Save offset 0x20c reads 0x00000000 in baseline.
fields.name: gem_shard_flags

fields.description: Accumulated play-time counter (frames/ticks; wide u32 accumulator).
fields.evidence: FUN_080447f8 scales integer quantities by 1000 (seconds-to-ms style timer conversion, used in the FUN_08044d38 update sequence); full u32 words are stored to state at +0x80/+0x84 by FUN_08022954/FUN_0802295c. Save offset 0x210 reads 0x00000000 in baseline.
fields.name: playtime_frames

fields.description: Boss-gate key flags (one bit per gate/boss unlocked).
fields.evidence: FUN_080450a0 writes 0xff-cleared flag bytes at state+0x5a/0x5b with enable byte +0x5d=1; FUN_08022a20 zero-initializes flag words (u32 at struct+0x6c=0). Save offset 0x214 reads 0x00 in baseline.
fields.name: boss_gate_keys

fields.description: Save-format/initialization tag byte; distinguishes a written save from erased flash.
fields.evidence: 0xff uninitialized-marker idiom: FUN_08046c7c writes 0xff to struct+0xb and FUN_080450a0 rewrites a 0xff sentinel at state+0x12 to 0 during init; a tag byte records that initialization ran. Save offset 0x215 reads 0x00 in baseline.
fields.name: save_version_tag
